design: Paired actual model-generated draft and evidence, isolated self/Python/SHACL final reviews
cohort: 12 authored development cases across4questionfamilies and3evidence states; not fresh heldout

model.note: Model alias plus fixed provider, returned model/provider captured; not immutable weights guarantee. No search, audio, images or explicit prompt caching.

scope.failure_policy: stop on first failed episode, no automatic retries; reservations never refunded

prospective_scoring_plan:
# Prospective answer scoring, development diagnostic

Freeze before paid execution. Twelve case cells are selected from four families informed by earlier inspected errors, not sampled factory users or fresh held-out data. One actual model-led draft per cell, three isolated finals reuse EXACT draft and evidence. Counterbalance final branch order across cases if implemented; otherwise preserve and disclose current self/Python/SHACL order. Do not regenerate a draft to obtain a useful error. No tools during finals, no runtime evaluator imports, no gold-based repair. Identical Python/SHACL prompts mean prose differences are model variability, not different information supplied by checker language.

Planned denominator: 12 episodes,12 drafts,36 final branches. Record not_attempted/failed/truncated/cancelled separately. A run may stop at cap; do not quietly replace cases. Every successful draft remains in comparison, including correct and uncertain drafts. Do not divide correctness only by successful/correctly interpreted episodes without also showing total denominator.

Per-answer coding has orthogonal fields:
- Core product/order/candidate judgment against SELECTED evidence under published policy.
- Full-source candidate/list recovery, separately; an unavailable source fact must not make evidence-grounded uncertainty a reasoning error.
- Qualification reason: not_retrieved versus not_applicable; policy is not physical approval.
- Citation existence plus proposition support, not merely bracket presence.
- Unsupported certainty: schedule, renewal documents, whole-enterprise absence, complete impact list, physical allocation.
- Unnecessary withholding only when selected evidence supports the requested bounded answer; withholding on missing evidence is not automatically unnecessary.
- Preservation of user constraints and unverified attribution.
- Specific human review pointer: named role or responsible function and fact/document to verify. Do not reward ungrounded recommended physical action.

Transitions per matched draft/final: corrected error, persistent error, introduced error, correct retained, uncertainty appropriately retained, unnecessary withholding introduced/resolved. Record claim text and exact E references; do not present manually segmented claims as independent samples. Family-level and per-cell table primary; no significance claim from four authored families.

Two independent native auditors receive arm-masked full question, actual selected evidence, tool catalog, source scope, texts and explicit scoring rubric. Source-recovery reference may be supplied only to auditors (never runtime), clearly separate from selected-evidence truth. Both return supporting exact quotes; coordinator verifies quotes/citations and adjudicates disagreements, preserving both annotations. Masking imperfect when answers mention report; disclose. No automated heuristic is treated as semantic truth. Offline checker parity is NOT answer scoring.

Expected information boundaries (not expected model answers): Q1/Q2/Q4 reports may expose qualification reason details; Q3 impact list is outside existing checker, so report must be not_assessed when no replacement candidates queried. A/O have same view facts and differ only in opaque source provenance after model projection; no correct-source-state-classification metric. Any whole-source absence claims are unsupported without declared complete retrieval.
provenance: Scoring plan prepared before paid launch; this public JSON copy assembled during execution; not external preregistration
limits: Same-policy Python essential; cannot infer RDF superiority
Source absence and projection omission not inferable from identical visible facts
